items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: He was a big conductor, writer. So he took me to play one Broadway show called 'Fast and Furious.'

ctx.x: I was -- hang around all day, and before I knew, I was speaking English. That I do know, because when -- no way for me to speak Spanish then. No Spanish people around here. You can hardly see one. So I have to either talk English or die.

So I begin to get acquainted with those guys. So I remember very -- my first job. A fellow, old man those days, used to be a very popular ragtime piano player called Luckey Roberts. He used to (inaudible), he used to play those swanky private parties for the rich people.
